name: Reverse Pyramid Strength
description: Three full-body workouts a week for 10 weeks. The main lifts are a reverse pyramid: after warm-up sets, the heaviest set comes first while you are fresh, then two lighter sets of more reps, about 10% lighter each. Few hard sets, so the workouts are short. Week 5 is a deload; the second block starts heavier. When the first set reaches the top of its range, add weight to all three sets next time. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.

phases.name: Reverse pyramid 6-8-10
phases.description: Three sets on the main lifts: the heaviest for 4 to 6 reps, then about 10% lighter for 6 to 8 and 8 to 10

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

phases.name: Reverse pyramid 5-7-9
phases.description: Heavier: 3 to 5 reps on the first set, then 5 to 7 and 7 to 9
